_comment: Per-role stat BUDGET SHARES for F-013 (derived from stock gear by `zep world item analyze-stat-shares`, stat_share_analyzer.py). Share = relative portion of an item's stat budget a stat gets within its role; the allocator (generator.distribute_stats) re-normalises across whichever stats an item rolls. NOT scaler.STAT_WEIGHT (the gem cost to convert budget->value). Unlisted stats default to 1.0.
